Dev Mode Arcade reimagines the developer portfolio as an arcade control panel — neon-lit, grid-structured, and packed with system-readout energy that makes every section feel like a live diagnostic feed from inside a cabinet. The design bridges the gap between a technical dashboard and a retro gaming interface, landing in a space that's equally at home on a monitor in a server room or glowing above a joystick in an arcade hall. This theme suits developers who want to project both technical credibility and unapologetic personality.

## Theme Overview

Dev Mode Arcade fuses two distinct visual worlds — the structured information density of a developer dashboard and the electric, high-energy visual language of an arcade game screen. Content panels are laid out in a modular grid that mimics control-panel instrumentation, with neon borders and glowing accents emphasising key data points. The dark background amplifies the neon palette, drawing the eye immediately to skills, projects, and contact details. Monospaced typography reinforces the technical character, while the overall composition has the immediate visual magnetism of an attract-mode screen cycling at the front of an arcade cabinet.

## Design Highlights

- Modular control-panel grid layout combining dashboard logic with arcade visual flair
- Neon borders and glowing accents against a deep dark background for maximum contrast
- System-readout presentation of developer skills, stack, and project highlights
- Monospaced type reinforcing the technical, mode-active persona of the design
- Arcade attract-screen energy that makes the portfolio immediately attention-grabbing

## Who This Theme Suits

Dev Mode Arcade is a strong choice for full-stack developers, software engineers, and technical professionals who have strong personalities and want their portfolio to reflect that. It is particularly well suited to those in game development, developer tooling, or any technical domain where enthusiasm and craft go hand in hand — and where a portfolio that communicates genuine love for the work is an asset.
